title: a record reached through a symlinked root is located
intention: The artifact door's locate() finds a record reached through a symlinked default root, so the gate guards the commons that hollow links beside its worktree.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 6cd13a3a5f42's hollow refused at HEAD because bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py read 12 FAILs in the hollow worktree. hollow links the standing commons beside the worktree as a symlink (19193ff1e41e); locate() resolves the asked path through the link but compares it against the unresolved default root _REPO.parent/CairnCommons, so relative_to fails and every commons record locates as None.
traces_to: Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics; the gate is physics only where locate() sees the record.
how: locate() compares the resolved path against Path(root).resolve(). A red-first proof points _REPO at a scratch wt whose sibling CairnCommons is a symlink and asks locate() through the link, at its target, and outside.

clauses.claim: a ticket path spelled through a symlinked default CairnCommons root locates as a CairnCommons record at tickets/<name>
the same ticket spelled at the link's target locates as the same root name and relative path
a path under neither root, and a non-record path (notes/) under the linked root, still locate as None

decisions.text: D1: locate() compares p against Path(root).resolve(), so every branch of roots() is judged in one spelling.
D2: the red-first proof drives roots()'s default branch over a scratch symlink layout, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: in a bare worktree with CairnCommons symlinked beside it, bin/proofs/test_artifact_gate.py read 12 FAILs and artifact.locate('<wt>/../CairnCommons/tickets/x.json') returned None; without the link it read GREEN
measured.how: git worktree add --detach + ln -s ~/dev/src/CairnCommons beside it, then bin/cairn test --exec over the proof and a python call to locate()
